title: feed_event has no run-incarnation identity, so terminal events cannot be told apart
body: Tick 55i offered two fixes for the replayed-terminal defect; this tick shipped the from-now cursor because the other option — a run-attempt identity on terminal events a subscriber can compare against — needs a field on the closed ticfac.run_event.v1 schema in the pinned bundle (contracts/run-event-feed.json, additionalProperties: false). A subscriber that wants history AND correct terminal attribution (a long-lived dashboard following from offset zero across a resume) can get it today only by re-deriving incarnations from run_resumed/stage orderings. If that use is wanted, the schema needs a deliberate, versioned field.
